# TinyCloud One

TinyCloud One is the app for using TinyCloud. Its Feed is where connected agents post cards and read your answers.

TinyCloud keeps your data in a space you control. Apps, assistants and people
reach it only through access you grant: an approval you sign, or a link you
share. Approvals are scoped and expire unless you choose to let them renew,
and ending one stops future reads. Connections to TinyCloud's hosted service
use HTTPS. The Data Vault encrypts values on your device before they're stored.
The hosted TinyCloud connector (MCP) handles the requests and results it passes
in readable form. An app or agent you approve receives what it reads and can
keep a copy.
Security and trust model: https://docs.tinycloud.xyz/concepts/security-and-trust
